attchmntText: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Dynacons Systems and Solutions Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement was published in Financial Express and Mumbai Lakshadweep on November 16, 2026. The standalone net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 88.06 lakhs. The consolidated net profit for the same period was Rs. 22.82 lakhs. The standalone basic earnings per share was Rs. 0.04. The consolidated basic earnings per share was Rs. 0.04. G-TEC Jainx Education Limited issued a corrigendum to its public announcement regarding an open offer. The offer price was voluntarily revised upward from Rs. 29 per equity share to Rs. 33 per equity share. SAB Events and Governance Now Media Limited announced its 13th Annual General Meeting. The meeting will be held on Thursday, December 10, 2026, at 12:15 P.M. via video conferencing.

attchmntText: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited Reports Q2 & H1 FY2027 Results ".
Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dynacons Systems and Solutions Limited approved its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The Board adopted the results along with the Limited Review Report from auditors MSP and Co. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported Net Sales of 55,122.30 lakh rupees and a Net Profit after Tax of 3,015.52 lakh rupees. Basic Earnings Per Share stood at 23.68. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, Net Sales were 86,241.63 lakh rupees with a Net Profit after Tax of 4,971.86 lakh rupees. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, amounted to 1,18,411.22 lakh rupees. The meeting commenced at 05:00 p.m. and concluded at 09:55 p.m.

attchmntText: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Dynacons Systems and Solutions Limited has secured an international order worth USD 6,831,084.46 from the Ministry of Public Works, Public Utilities and Digital Economy, Caribbean Digital Transformation Project Unit, Commonwealth of Dominica. The contract involves the supply, installation, configuration, and maintenance of IT infrastructure for the Health Management and Information System across three hospitals, 49 health centres, and two wellness centres in Dominica. The project duration is three years. This is the company's first international order. The entity awarding the order is an international entity. The order does not fall within related party transactions. No promoter or group company has an interest in the awarding entity. The announcement was filed on 12.11.2026.
